title: Line continuation
requirements: This is a proposed minimal illustration of the narrated underscore contrast, not a screenshot of the supplied program. Retain the explicit underscore; do not claim every modern VB multiline expression always requires one.
Left column C#, right column VB. Use equal area and the same code font size; do not make either language artificially harder to read.
Retain literal supplied examples where present. Proposed counterparts must be recorded as agent-authored explanatory snippets and checked in an isolated context, not committed to Program.vb.
Ellipses mean an intentional excerpt, never runnable complete source. Only the compared tokens receive accent highlighting.
beats: Still: both code columns visible at once.
Focus overlay: highlight the specific contrasting tokens without changing layout.
checks: Both column headings and the exact comparison subject are visible.
Comparable examples use matching loop bounds/data where applicable.
The code does not make a stronger semantic-equivalence claim than the source supports.
A 720p proof has legible punctuation and no clipped code.
